newsitem.title: USA: Cascade provides switches for Bell Atlantic, NYNEX.
newsitem.headline: Cascade provides switches for Bell Atlantic, NYNEX.

text.p: Cascade Communications Corp said Monday it is providing its CBX 500 Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) switches for the wireless network of Bell Atlantic NYNEX Mobile, a joint venture of Bell Atlantic Corp and NYNEX Corp.
The digital Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA) network will provide service for areas including Washington, Baltimore, Philadelphia, New York, as well as parts of New Jersey and New England.
The company said two to five of Cascade's ATM switches will be in each region to support the service.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
